Holding on tight may say more about trust than about money.

Kevin Trudeau says that hoarding money, time or love shows you believe the supply is limited. In his view, that comes from not trusting there is enough.

He teaches that giving and forgiving go hand in hand, and that generosity is part of any spiritual practice.

Where in your life are you holding on too tightly?
